method: perfect-removal upper bound = optimizer_ms (separate AdamCUDA launch eliminated by C7 fusion); realistic O_net discounts fusion overhead.

components.name: two-stage sorting
components.rationale: exact but perfect upper bound <3% E2E; C0 sort not bottleneck

components.name: opacity-aware 3D filter
components.rationale: prohibited: changes rendering/quality; not exact systems gain

components.name: backward->optimizer fusion
components.rationale: Oracle upper-bound (optimizer_ms 8.5/20.5/17.3% E2E) assumed fusion eliminates optimizer_ms. EMPIRICALLY FALSIFIED on C0: C0 H8_MR backward (HigsNativeBackward.cu) is MULTI-KERNEL tile-based (blend->projection->sh_vjp) with atomicAdd scatter + data deps; Adam (AdamCUDA.cu, separate core module) must run AFTER all stages => sequential, CANNOT overlap. Fusion only removes kernel LAUNCH overhead.
components.decision: DROP (realistic O_net <0.15% E2E << 2% threshold). Full optimizer_ms elimination requires per-primitive backward restructure = out-of-scope research, not a port.

components.name: Morton/Z-order densification
components.rationale: Measured on pinned C0 .so (no-CUDA microbench, interleaved A/B/A/B inverse-perm restore, gsplat env torch2.9.1, A100). Morton reordering changes raster fwd+bwd by +1.35%/+0.52%/+3.31% (room/garden/bicycle, N=852K/2.57M/3.70M); optimizer step ~0% (layout-invariant). Per-iter E2E = 0.54/0.34/2.08%; full-training E2E (apply-once post-densification) = 0.27/0.17/1.04%. Benefit confined to backward atomicAdd scatter (C0 backward is TILE-SORTED, not global-order => weak coherence vs Faster-GS fused per-primitive backward). Within measurement noise for room/garden (~8% fwd+bwd noise > effect); reorder overhead during densification is net-negative. Realistic O_net << 3% E2E on all scenes => DROP. See SB0_C8_EVALUATION.json.

components.name: frontend allocation/densification mem
components.rationale: memory handling; not an E2E wall-clock lever on C0

summary: All DISTINCT_AND_EXACT components DROP on authoritative C0: C1 (two-stage sort, perfect UB<3%), C7 (backward->optimizer fusion, empirically falsified <0.15% E2E), C8 (morton densification, measured 0.17-1.04% full-train E2E <3% bar), C9 (frontend alloc, not an E2E lever). C2/C4/C5/C6 ALREADY_IN_C0; C3 DISTINCT_BUT_APPROXIMATE (prohibited). NO component clears the >=3% E2E implementation gate => no C0 production CUDA modification is warranted.

evidence: HigsNativeBackward.cu: higs_blend_bwd_kernel + higs_projection_bwd_kernel + higs_sh_vjp_grid_kernel (3+ separate __global__ launches, atomicAdd to v_means/v_conic/v_opacities/v_sh).
AdamCUDA.cu: separate adam_kernel launch (gsplat.csrc core module), reads param_grad from global memory.
SelectiveAdam.step() calls adam() per param group (5 groups) AFTER loss.backward().
Empirical: CUDA launch overhead = 4.80us (noop kernel microbench, A100). x5 groups = 24us/iter = <0.15% E2E.
optimizer_ms (2.513/8.422/6.539) is memory-bound compute, NOT launch overhead; cannot be eliminated without overlap.
c7_re_evaluation.conclusion: C7 does NOT translate Faster-GS speedup to C0. DROP.

c8_re_evaluation.method: no-CUDA microbench on pinned C0 .so, interleaved A/B/A/B, gsplat env (torch 2.9.1), A100
